messages.body:
*Dear Amber users,*
*Maybe a useful question to everyone..*
*Based on this link here
http://ambermd.org/Questions/mm_pbsa.html#check_atom_nr_prmtop_and_crd_differ
<
http://ambermd.org/Questions/mm_pbsa.html#check_atom_nr_prmtop_and_crd_differ
>
what could the command line to be used to ensure that coordinate (i.e.
snapshot_com.crd.1)  and topology files (i.e. .prmtop)  are matching? if
possible, could you please provide an example?*
This is a very frequent MM-PB(GB)/SA error messages
http://ambermd.org/Questions/mm_pbsa.html
Thank you!
